name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: TRIGGER-SELECTOR BUILD (v4): 0.4.38's same-window-resend warning was reported to make sending stop working entirely, appearing even on what should be a brand new window's first attempt right after a Thunderbird restart. Two defensive fixes while this is investigated: (1) the Services.prompt.alert() warning call is now wrapped in try/catch -- if it throws in this context for any reason, the real send underneath it must still proceed, since a broken warning is a minor annoyance but a broken send is not; (2) every ComposeProcessDone(aResult) call is now logged unconditionally (not just when sendError is enabled), to confirm or rule out the live hypothesis that it fires with a non-zero code for reasons unrelated to an actual failed Send click, which would incorrectly flag a brand new window as already-failed.
